name: io.github.johnnyclem/jcas-mcp
title: JCAppleScript
description: Control macOS apps via AppleScript/JXA: sanitized commands for Messages, Mail, Finder, and more.

environmentVariables.name: JCAS_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable tools that execute arbitrary code (execute_applescript, execute_jxa, tell_application) and registry commands flagged dangerous.

environmentVariables.name: JCAS_APP_MANIFESTS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated list of JSON manifest files with additional community app definitions to load at startup.
